Restricting theta to the positive arc angle 0<theta<=2pi repairs the claim, including a full turn for zeta=1. Sector conjugacy and the Gronwall limit establish exactly the characteristic-polynomial assertion, without diagonalizability.

Its dependency proves Euler commutators (1.1), standard eigenvalues (2.1), Euler local finiteness (2.2-3.1), finite generalized weight spaces (4.1), and finite length (7.1). The present step 1.1 itself derives the spectrum inclusion Sigma+Z>=0 from standard simple quotients and a finite composition series, and proves exactness by taking the appropriate generalized eigencomponent of a preimage. Thus the alleged absent uniform-bound prerequisites are actually proved, rather than assumed from the shorter supplier Statement.

The associated-graded algebra in F2 and step 1.1 was incorrectly written (P smash W) tensor C[h], which makes W commute with the y-symbols. The crossed-product relation w y w^{-1}=w(y) survives the y filtration, so the correct algebra is (P tensor C[h]) smash W with diagonal action. The repaired graded map is coefficientwise localization in the direct sum over W, hence injective; leading symbols then prove injectivity of the Dunkl map. This is a logic defect in the written graded-algebra identification.

The cited standard-residue lemma proves the polynomial identity [y,f]=partial_y(f)-sum_s c_s alpha_s(y)(f-sf)/alpha_s s in its step 1.1, before imposing any zero inducing action. In the present induced module, y(f tensor v)=[y,f](1 tensor v)+f tensor yv. Adding the localization correction sum_s c_s alpha_s(y)/alpha_s (1-s) cancels the sf tensor sv terms and gives exactly the displayed step 1.1 formula, with f tensor yv retained. This is a direct calculation already stated here, not an unsupported application of the standard-module-only connection conclusion.
